MODEL_NOT_FOUND: No folder by that name and no such model on the Hugging Face Hub.
OUT_OF_MEMORY: The GPU (or CPU) ran out of memory.
NO_TEXT_LAYER: A PDF with no text: a scan or photos of pages.
PASSWORD_PROTECTED: A PDF that needs a password to open.
ENCRYPTED_NEEDS_CRYPTOGRAPHY: An AES-encrypted PDF and no cryptography package.
UNSUPPORTED_FILE_TYPE: A file type no reader handles.
FILE_NOT_FOUND: A path that does not exist.
FETCH_FAILED: A URL that could not be fetched.
PICKLE_WEIGHTS_ONLY: A model whose weights exist only in the pickle (.bin) format, which can run code when loaded.
NOT_A_SET: No document set by that name or in that folder.
NOT_A_RUN: No training run by that id or in that folder.
INVALID_ARGUMENTS: A tool was called with arguments its contract does not allow.
NOT_ALLOWED: The policy does not let this agent call this tool.
NEEDS_APPROVAL: The policy says a person must approve this call first; a request was recorded.
BUDGET_EXHAUSTED: An agent used its whole step budget without finishing.
GPU_BUSY: Another heavy GPU job (training, question writing, evaluation, merging) is still running.
AGENT_MODEL_TOO_SMALL: The model is smaller than the policy allows for this agent (3B by default); use the fixed workflows.
NOT_REPLAYABLE: The event is not a recorded read-only call or agent task, so it cannot be replayed.
NOT_EVALUATED: The run has no evaluation (held-out loss, metrics or a judge), so it cannot be proposed as a model version.
